share.title: Share trip
share.explain: Anyone with the link can see this trip (map, timeline, photos and videos) without logging in. Private notes, expenses and the budget are not shown.
share.invalid: This link is no longer valid.

expenses.empty: No expenses in this trip yet.

tracks.title: GPS tracks
tracks.empty: Upload a GPX or KML file (from your watch, Strava, Wikiloc, Google My Maps…) to draw the route.
tracks.invalid: The file has no tracks or is not a valid GPX/KML.

backup.title: Backup
backup.exportExplain: Download a ZIP with every trip, photo and video (originals included).
backup.restoreExplain: Restoring a backup replaces all current trips with the ones in it. The current database is kept aside (pre-restore-…db) just in case.
backup.confirmRestore: ALL trips will be replaced with the ones in "{{name}}". Continue?
